children.name: Evidence
children.value: The UsacConfig at 0x23D has the layout exhale writes: an audio pre-roll element first, then only channel elements without time-warped MDCT and no fill element, SBR defaults of start frequency 15 without harmonic SBR or PVC, and one loudness info extension of 8 bytes with one measurement

findings.message: USAC access units are read only up to their usacIndependencyFlag; their coding is not analyzed yet.
